## How billing works

### Billing and usage

1

**Per-seat subscription**

You’re billed for each seat. Your organization’s shared usage increases with the number of seats you purchase.

2

**Continue working after you reach your usage limit**

On eligible paid plans, auto-reload lets you continue working after you reach your usage limit. You can turn it off at any time in Settings. On Free, you can resume when your daily usage resets.

### Administration and support

## Try Studio free for 7 days

Put Studio to work with 7 days of free access to your selected plan. A payment method is required to start your trial. When the trial ends, your paid subscription will begin automatically.

[Start for free](https://studio.upstage.ai/) [Contact sales](https://www.upstage.ai/contact-us)

## Frequently asked questions

[Start for free](https://studio.upstage.ai/) [Contact sales](https://www.upstage.ai/contact-us)

Q.

What can I do on the Free plan?

Everything in Studio. There is no feature limit, only a daily usage allowance. Once you use it up, you wait until it refills the next day.

Q.

What happens when I use up my usage?

On paid plans you can keep going by purchasing extra credits, or upgrade to a higher plan if you need more usage. Auto top-up can be turned off in settings. On Free, new jobs cannot run until the next renewal.

Q.

Can I try it for free first?

Free is the default plan. For 7 days after sign-up you can use every Studio feature at a higher plan's usage level, and then continue on Free.

Q.

What happens to my documents if I cancel?

Your organization and memberships remain, and only usage returns to the Free level. Stored documents stay viewable and downloadable, and the deletion period counts from the cancellation date.

Q.

Can I get a refund?

Within 7 days of prepayment, if you have not used the additional usage, we refund in full. For other mid-term cancellations, contact us and we will advise based on remaining usage.

Q.

I was already using Studio. What changes?

Subscription plans apply from September 21, 2026. Without a separately negotiated contract you move to the Free plan, and you need to choose a plan to keep going.

Q.

What is different about Enterprise?

Usage limits, SLA, role management, connector integration, and support scope are set by contract. Contact sales for on-premises or air-gapped environments as well.
